observed_semantics: Unverified; no accounting meaning inferred from field name
fixture: Minimal sanitized reproduction of the observed shape. Report, item and offer identities, prices and the precision-stressing amount are synthetic; this is not a raw provider capture.
retention: Exact decimal numeric lexeme, missing/null/zero/value distinctions and source fingerprint; base contract version is unchanged
accounting_gate: Both delivery and return component must be explicit known zero under ZERO_ONLY. Missing, null, positive or negative values require separate accounting review. Null return_commission is never inferred to mean zero returns.
compatibility: Only absent new field is omitted in sanitized serialization so old immutable preview/source hashes remain unchanged. Newly observed null, zero or value changes source fingerprint.
